rows.description: Lecture Notes for Linear Algebra Featuring Python. This series of lecture notes will walk you through all the must-know concepts that set the foundation of data science or advanced quantitative skillsets. Suitable for statistician/econometrician, quantitative analysts, data scientists and etc. to quickly refresh the linear algebra with the assistance of Python computation and visualization.
